title: End-To-End Clo Virtual Series | Webinar 01: Custom Asset Library - Create & Manage
description:
Webinar 01: Custom Asset Library - Create & Manage: 
The first webinar will help you create & manage your custom digital library of CLO assets, like:
     1. Avatar
     2. Pattern
     3. Fabric & Texture
     4. Hardware & Trim

Time Stamps :
0:00 : Intro
2:12 : About Digital Asset Library
5:52 : Default Avatars in CLO
11:33 : CLO Avatar Editor
16:00 : Auto COnvert to Avatar
18:05 : Draft Patterns in CLO
32:02 : Pattern Drafter
37:03 : AI Pattern Drafter
40:02 : Fabrics in CLO
43:40 : AI Fabric Creator
48:50 : Texture Generator
49:56 : Auto PBR Map Generator
52:53 : Texture Editor
56:38 : Trims on CLO
1:11:47 : Asset management on CLO-SET
1:20:08 : User management on CLO-SET

About the End-to-End CLO Virtual Series: 
A set of workflow-based webinars incorporating all the new CLO features to optimize your entire 3D product development process.

Webinar series line-up:
     1. Webinar 01: Custom Asset Library - Create & Manage 
     2. Webinar 02: Design Proto - Ideate, Create & Review
     3. Webinar 03: Fit Proto - Create & Review
     4. Webinar 04: Production Ready
     5. Webinar 05: Marketing & E-Commerce

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://discord.gg/SSPtURg6hj
--- 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/itsclo3d 
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/clo-virtual-fashion-inc-/ 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/clo3d/
